title: Communication with those charged with governance — Ashby Foods
instructions: Review the draft end-of-audit letter to **Ashby Foods'** audit committee and correct the highlighted wording.

parts.prompt: Select the correct wording for each highlighted phrase.

segments.text:
To the Audit Committee of Ashby Foods

**Our responsibility.** Our audit was designed to obtain

about whether the statements are free of material misstatement.

**Significant findings.** Management's estimate of the inventory obsolescence reserve is the most sensitive estimate.

segments.original: We disagreed with management about revenue cutoff, but because the matter was resolved we do not report it.
options: We disagreed with management about revenue cutoff, but because the matter was resolved we do not report it.
We disagreed with management about revenue cutoff; the matter was resolved to our satisfaction.
segments.answer: We disagreed with management about revenue cutoff; the matter was resolved to our satisfaction.
segments.explanation: Disagreements are communicated whether or not resolved.

segments.original: We have not listed uncorrected misstatements because each is immaterial.
options: We have not listed uncorrected misstatements because each is immaterial.
The attached schedule summarizes uncorrected misstatements, other than clearly trivial ones.
segments.answer: The attached schedule summarizes uncorrected misstatements, other than clearly trivial ones.
segments.explanation: Uncorrected misstatements (other than clearly trivial) are communicated.

segments.text: **Representations.** We have requested certain written representations from management,

segments.answer: a copy of which is attached
